test_eval_statements: test evaluating Python statements from C++ and capture printed output
test_eval_single_statement: test evaluating a single Python expression from C++ and assert the result
test_eval_file: test evaluating a Python file from C++ by passing its filename path
test_eval_empty_globals: test that eval with empty globals still injects __builtins__ into the namespace
test_eval_closure: test that eval closures correctly isolate global and local variable scopes
